additions.reason: Text line 90: 'ויראה היא בשת, ירא בשת, נמצא שזה העזות דקדושה נמשך מבשת'. The text explicitly states יראה IS בשת (shame = awe) — these are two names for the same essential reality. While בשת is already in the dataset connected to עדן (edge 23868: בשת -- עדן), the יראה -- בשת bechina appears to be missing. Adding בשת as a bechina of יראה would strengthen Package 1's coherence, since יראה is already a dominant node in that package. Note: check if this edge already exists before adding.

The text systematically uses 'חותם הרגלין' (the seal of the legs/rebukers) as a distinct node — the outer seal formed by the rebukers. 'חותם הוא, כי יש מוכיחי הדור, והם בחינות רגלין... ועל שם זה הן בחינת חותם'. This is a bechina: רגלים = חותם הרגלין (the rebukers ARE the seal). The concept 'חותם הרגלין' is used repeatedly throughout the Torah to refer to the outer seal (distinguished from חותם הידין = faith). Adding this node would make the seal-structure explicit in the dataset and connect to Package 5.

analysis_notes.notes_on_component_A: The main component A (25 nodes) is exceptionally large because Torah #22 builds a tight chain of equivalences: בראשית = מאמר השלם = נשמע = תפלה = קדם הבריאה = אין סוף = עדן עלאה = חכמה עלאה = אבא = יראה = תחלה = אין (ענוה). This is intentional — the Torah's core argument is that all these are one domain (the transcendent/hidden/prayer dimension).
